title: Personalized learning management system using semantic web based learning style detection
reason: System proposal: an ontology (Protégé) infers a learner's Kolb style from tracked activity choice, frequency, time and results. Output is shown as Protégé query screenshots; no participants, dataset or validation against a measured style.

extraction.lms_indicators: activity choice, access frequency, time spent, results (designed, not analysed)
extraction.notes: Journal of Chemical and Pharmaceutical Sciences (out-of-field venue).
